name: Hoshizora e Kakaru Hashi AA
source:
The fandisk for Hoshikaka, containing after stories for the 6 heroines and another stories for new heroine Seira and subchars Senka and Yocchan. The new routes take place one year after Kazuma first came to Yamabiko city. Ui and Hina’s Valentine’s Day routes from the special patch will now be fully voiced, with episodes for other characters coming out too.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《架向星空之桥》的Fan Disc，收录六位女主角的后日谈，以及新女主角七森星罗、配角万千歌与小佳的全新故事。新路线发生在星野一马初次来到山比古市的一年后。此前特别补丁收录的中津川初与酒井阳菜情人节路线如今将加入完整配音，其他角色也会有新的篇章登场。

[据[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]内容编辑]
